meta.name: The Trap
meta.description: Follow famous author Lisa Konrad, who has not left her house for a decade after witnessing the murder of her sister. One night she sees who she believes was the murdered on television, and decides to use herself as bait to catch them.

videos.title: The Monster
videos.overview: When reclusive author Lisa Konrad believes she recognizes her sister's murderer on TV, she hatches a dangerous plan to bring him to justice.

videos.title: The Novel
videos.overview: Despite her publisher's concerns, Lisa dives deeper into her novel and her memories. Meanwhile, Robert Lenzen researches his interview subject.

videos.title: The Training
videos.overview: Lisa prepares herself for the meeting with Robert, unaware that he's doing the same. Norbert consults with Lisa's therapist about her behavior.

videos.title: The Interview
videos.overview: When Robert arrives for the interview, Lisa relies on her training to stay in control of the situation — but the tables keep turning on her.

videos.title: The Confession
videos.overview: A devastated Lisa clutches desperately for answers. A confession from Norbert suggests that Anna's killer is closer than she thinks.

videos.title: The Truth
videos.overview: As the line between reality and fiction becomes increasingly blurred, Lisa attempts to face her biggest fear to get the answers she's been waiting for.
